_note: Monitoring alert rules (B-83) as versioned data. Thresholds are prototype defaults, not tuned on real traffic. Change a number here, never in code. 'version' is the file format version.

rules.summary: An audit chain failed verification: a record was edited, removed or reordered.
A model provider's circuit breaker is open and calls are failing fast.
Model-call budget denials: a scope has used its calls or tokens for the window.
A proposal has waited for a lead's decision longer than the allowed age.
Dead-lettered jobs for a client grew faster than the allowed rate.
